## History

John Douglas courted [Janet](../character/janet.md) for twenty years after first walking her home, though he remained unable to propose while living with his subtly manipulative mother. When [Janet](../character/janet.md) coldly rejected his offer to walk her home on her fortieth birthday following Anne's advice, John was left visibly hurt until [Anne](../character/anne.md) brought him back. Shortly after his mother passed away, John visited [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) and proposed to [Janet](../character/janet.md), revealing that his late mother had forced him to swear a secret oath never to marry while she was still alive.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P3](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0003), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P6](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0006), [v3 ch.Douglas P11](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0011), [v3 ch.Douglas P12](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0012), [v3 ch.Douglas P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016), +70 more_

## Quotes

> "And this is our new teacher. I’m delighted to meet you. My son has been singing your praises until I’m half jealous, and I’m sure Janet ought to be wholly so."
>
> — John Douglas — [v3 ch.Douglas P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016)

> "I am a very frail old woman, Miss Shirley. For over twenty years I’ve been a great sufferer. For twenty long, weary years I’ve been dying by inches."
>
> — John Douglas — [v3 ch.Douglas P23](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0023)

> “Come and see me soon again, dear Janet,” said Mrs. Douglas lovingly, when they left. “You don’t come half often enough. But then I suppose John will be bringing you here to stay all the time one of these days.”
>
> — John Douglas — [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)

> “How do you do, Janet dear?” she said sweetly. “I am so glad to see you again, dear.”
>
> — John Douglas — [v3 ch.Douglas P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016)

> "I was looking at you in prayer-meeting, miss, and thinking what a nice little girl you were."
>
> — John Douglas — [v3 ch.Douglas P6](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0006)
